name: studio-assist-move-repours-fill
description: Owner QA: moving an island outline drawn before the grass flood fill was refused as changing another object's art, because the grass pours around the outline and so re-pours when it moves. A move of the selected item's own commands is a candidate; the grass's new pour is a side effect the tool result names, with its cells and box, for the model and the creator to judge.

studio.source:

end
